headline: China Schedules Shenzhou-24 Launch and Names Pakistani Payload Specialist
deck: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is scheduled to join two Chinese astronauts; the agency says he will return aboard Shenzhou-23.
body: China has scheduled Shenzhou-24 to lift off aboard a Long March 2F rocket on Wednesday from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, China Manned Space Agency spokesperson Zhang Jingbo said [E4]. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, a wing commander in the Pakistan Air Force, is scheduled to fly with Tang Hongbo, the mission commander, and Wu Yi, a spaceflight engineer [E3].

The China Manned Space Agency said Ali will be the mission’s payload specialist and the first foreign astronaut to board Tiangong [E1]. Zhang said Ali will work on joint China-Pakistan experiments, including installing samples and units and conducting scheduled experiments in orbit [E2]. Ali is to return aboard Shenzhou-23 [E5]; the agency said propellant loading was scheduled to begin at the launch tower later Tuesday [E6].
